transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we begin the cross-functional review for the proposed sale of our $12,000,000 commercial receivables pool to Meridian Receivables Fund, I'd like to go through each area systematically. We have Meridian's draft offer of $11,700,000 on the table, along with their request for customary seller support on collection shortfalls. Before I can authorize this transaction, I need each of you — legal, credit risk, servicing operations, and financial crime compliance — to report any unresolved items from your respective reviews. Let's start with legal.
